Class BlazeBiteOrdersTest

@IsTest()
private class BlazeBiteOrdersTest

Unit tests for BlazeBiteOrders. Validates deserialization of Firestore order JSON into strongly-typed Apex objects including order fields, line items, customizations, options, and pagination tokens.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void ordersTest()

Tests deserialization of a full Firestore orders JSON payload. Verifies order count, pagination, document fields (customer name, phone, payment method, status, location, timestamps), line items (name, price, index, defaults), customizations (selection type, options, selected options), and FirestoreNumericField default/decimal handling.
